reference: Synthetic fixture: unshocked features and saved scores of 8 customers

register.cohort: customers with an active FD in the 31 Jan 2024 snapshot (before the shock)
register.competitor_pass_through_use: context only; not used in the transformation
register.migrant_rule: each FD of a customer assigned to exit that matures in the window is closed from its maturity in the snapshots where the baseline shows it ACTIVE (status CLOSED, balances 0); an FD already closed, or without post-maturity snapshots, is left unchanged and is not counted as an exit
register.non_migrant_rule: each FD of other customers that matures in the window and is still ACTIVE after maturity is repriced at its offer rate + own pass-through x shock; only FDs whose rate actually changes are counted
register.pass_through_note: Own-bank pass-through affects the simulated FD offer rate. Competitor pass-through provides scenario context. Exit shares are separate illustrative assumptions, not estimated responses to the rate gap.
register.renewal_rule: an FD changes only at a maturity date (shown in the Jan 2024 snapshot) between 1 Mar and 30 Apr 2024, and only in post-maturity snapshots where the baseline still shows it ACTIVE; baseline closures are preserved and no account is re-opened; a missing post-maturity snapshot is never created; no early withdrawal is assumed
register.transaction_response: off: transaction activity, digital engagement and service-friction input values are held constant; scenario-specific SHAP explanations are not computed
